name: JSONPlaceholder
description:
A free fake REST API for testing and prototyping, with posts, comments, users and todos.

Every method works, but writes are faked: you get a realistic response and nothing is actually saved. That makes it a safe place to practise POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.

requests.name: List posts
requests.description: Returns all 100 posts. Switch on userId to get just one user's posts.

params.description: Only posts by this user (1 to 10)

requests.name: Get a post
requests.description: Returns one post by its id (1 to 100) at the end of the URL.

requests.name: Comments on a post
requests.description: Returns the comments on one post.

params.description: The post to get comments for

requests.name: Create a post
requests.description: Pretends to create a post and sends it back with a new id (always 101).

requests.name: Replace a post
requests.description: Replaces the whole post. Any field you leave out is missing from the response.

requests.name: Update part of a post
requests.description: Changes only the fields you send and keeps the rest.

requests.name: Delete a post
requests.description: Pretends to delete the post. Responds with 200 and an empty object.

requests.name: List todos
requests.description: Returns 200 todos. Switch on the params to filter them.

params.description: true for done, false for still to do
